_comment: ONS direct-debit failure rate (headline Total NSA, % of attempted DD transactions). Sourced from the ONS 'Monthly Direct Debit failure rate and average transaction amount' dataset — Total NSA series (Figure 4 of the accompanying real-time-indicators bulletin; in the 2026 xlsx edition a 'Total SA' sheet was inserted as sheet 1, shifting Total NSA to sheet 2). Shipping July 2026 = 2.44% (Total NSA), the most recent month in the 20 August 2026 edition (bulletin Figure 4 CSV: Jul 2026 Total 2.44). Series tail for reference: May 2026 = 2.35%, Jun 2026 = 2.39%, Jul 2026 = 2.44%. See dd-failure-rate-history.json for the full curated back-series. The curator `ons_dd_failure` spec owns live freshness via the artefact relay; this fixture is the ingest fallback / seed tier.
